newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Bomb wounds two Algerian poll observers - party.
newsitem.headline: Bomb wounds two Algerian poll observers - party.

text.p: A bomb wrecked a car carrying local election observers in central Algeria on Thursday, seriously wounding two observers, sources at an Islam-oriented party contesting the poll said.

The Movement of a Peaceful Society (MPS) sources said the explosion occurred at Ain Ma'bed village, 15 km (nine miles) from the central city of Dgelfa. There was no official confirmation of the blast.
The sources told Reuters the wounded men were representatives of political parties in an official committee supervising the general election. They gave no further details.
Suspected Moslem rebels, who oppose the election, have launched three bombings in the capital Algiers in the run-up to the election. At least 22 people were killed in the bombings.
Security forces stepped up security in Algiers and other areas on Wednesday to ensure a peaceful parliamentary election.
